newsitem.title: USA: Female Health completes debenture sale.
newsitem.headline: Female Health completes debenture sale.

text.p: Female Health Co on Monday said it completed a private placement of $2.020,000 in eight percent convertible debentures due January 31, 2000, and related warrants to buy common stock.
The debentures may be converted into common stock at the market price on the day of the close or at 80 percent of the market price on the date of conversion, whichever is less.
Fifty percent of the debentures may be converted 45 days after closing, and the remainder may be converted 60 days after closing.
The company owns worldwide rights to a female condom.
Proceeds will go toward commercial development of the female condom on a global basis, the company said.
The Joint United Nations Programme on HIV/AIDS recently told the company that it would require more than eight milion female condoms this year, with funding now in place for half, Female Health said.
The company said its partners in Japan, Taiwan and Canada planned to launch the product this year.
Discussions with prospective partners are taking place for marketing the product in Australia, Bangladesh, China, the European Union, India, Mexico, New Zealand and Russia.
